newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek OTE to post 97 profit over 320 bln drs-minister.
newsitem.headline: Greek OTE to post 97 profit over 320 bln drs-minister.

text.p: Greece's Transport and Communications Minister Harris Kastanidis said that OTE telecom will post pretax profits in excess of 320 billion drachmas ($1.2 billion) in 1997 versus an earlier projection of 304 billion.
"They (pretax profits) will exceed 320 billion drachmas," Kastanidis told parliament on Friday.
Pretax profits reached 250.1 billion drachmas in 1996 and prospectus projections put 1997 pretax earnings at 304.4 billion drachmas.
OTE's part-flotation ended on Friday and early indications showed that the private placement with institutional investors and the public offering to retail investors was comfortably oversubscribed.
The shares closed at 7,095 drachmas on heavy volume, down 105 drachmas. ($ = 274.2 Greek Drachmas)
